mentions.name: Kavla SQL canvas with agents
mentions.description: A SQL canvas web app with AI agents added on top. The agents work within the canvas, where every step is visible, making their actions relatively easy to audit. Examples include analyzing the best time to post on Hacker News and generating an interactive map of 20,000 earthquakes. Agent usage is currently free (sign-up required) while the author burns remaining credits.
